import type { IconName } from "@unicron/ui"

type Kind = "mail" | "search" | "delete"
type View = "all" | "archive" | "delete"

/** Typed as a Record: the values are icons, the keys are not. */
export const KIND_ICONS: Record<Kind, IconName> = {
  mail: "email",
  search: "search",
  "delete": "trash-can",
}

export const PARTIAL: Partial<Record<string, IconName>> = { done: "checkmark--outline", failed: "warning" }

// Named like an icon map, typed by inference.
const CHANGE_ICON = { added: "add", modified: "edit", deleted: "subtract", renamed: "folder--move-to" } as const
export const GAMING_ICON = { paused: "pause--outline", migrated: "arrows--horizontal" } as const satisfies Record<string, IconName>
export const STATES = { queued: "time", stopped: "stop--outline" } satisfies Record<string, IconName>

// A tuple with one icon slot: only that slot changes.
export type Screen = readonly [View, IconName, string]
export const VIEWS: Array<[View, IconName]> = [
  ["all", "folder"],
  ["archive", "archive"],
  ["delete", "trash-can"],
]
export const SCREENS: ReadonlyArray<Screen> = [
  ["archive", "archive", "Archive"],
  ["delete", "trash-can", "Deleted"],
]
const METHODS: Record<string, [IconName, string]> = {
  password: ["password", "password"],
  code: ["time", "one-time code"],
}

export const NAV: { id: string; label: string; icon: IconName }[] = [
  { id: "home", label: "Home", icon: "home" },
  { id: "search", label: "Search", icon: "search" },
  { id: "settings", label: "Settings", icon: busy() ? "hourglass" : "settings" },
]
export const LIST: IconName[] = ["star", "flag", "trash-can"]
export const icons = ["email", "calendar"]

export interface Step {
  icon: "sun" | "moon" | "contrast"
  mark?: IconName
  label: string
}

export function kindIcon(kind: string): IconName {
  if (kind === "delete") return "trash-can"
  switch (kind) {
    case "mail":
      return "email"
    case "search":
      return "search"
    default:
      return KIND_ICONS[kind as Kind] ?? "categories"
  }
}
const classIcon = (c: string) => (c === "employer" ? "portfolio" : c === "personal" ? "user" : "help")
export const fileIcon = (mime: string): IconName => {
  const labels = ["mail", "delete"].map((word) => word.toUpperCase())
  if (labels.includes(mime)) return "image"
  return "document--blank"
}
export function label(kind: string): string {
  return kind === "mail" ? "mail" : "search"
}

function Row({ icon = "document", glyph: mark = "password" }: { icon?: IconName; glyph?: IconName }) {
  let revealGlyph: IconName = busy() ? "view--off" : "view"
  revealGlyph = "locked"
  return [icon, mark, revealGlyph, CHANGE_ICON, METHODS, classIcon]
}

// Not icons: ordinary words in ordinary places.
const mode = "search"
const actions = ["add", "close", "delete"]
const lookup = { search: true, close: "close", kind: "mail" }
if (mode === "close" || actions.includes("add")) console.log(lookup["search"], `add ${mode} close`, /"delete"/.test(mode))
declare function busy(): boolean
export { Row }
